model: QuickServer M-Bus profile - Siemens FUE950 Energy
equipment_type: Heat / energy meter (M-Bus) via QuickServer gateway
applies_to: Siemens FUE950 Energy M-Bus meters read by an MSA FieldServer QuickServer (FS-QS-1X50/1X51) with its built-in Siemens FUE950 Energy M-Bus data profile.
summary: The QuickServer M-Bus gateway polls the meter as an M-Bus master and serves its data as 19 read-only Analog Inputs (BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP) plus matching Modbus input registers. The object list is the gateway's fixed Siemens FUE950 Energy profile from the start-up guide.
notes: The guide prints point name, BACnet object (all Analog Inputs) and Modbus register only; no units, scaling or descriptions.
The guide does not explain the numbered Energy, Volume and Time Point objects; confirm each against the meter display.
All values are floats; on the Modbus side the first register holds the least significant word.
Access is inferred: Analog Inputs are read-only.

source.title: QuickServer Start-up Guide FS-QS-1011/12X0/12X1/1X50/1X51 (Appendix B, M-Bus Data Profiles)

integration.summary: Set the meter's M-Bus primary address and readout as its maker describes, wire it to the QuickServer's M-Bus port (R2), pick this profile, then read the Analog Inputs.
setup: The meter connects to the QuickServer's M-Bus R2 port (+/-; most M-Bus devices are not polarity sensitive); on some models a jumper sets the port as M-Bus master or slave.
gotchas: Units are not given; check the meter's M-Bus data records for each value's unit and scale.
